name: Ranger 7 impact site (Mare Cognitum)
description: Local lunar surface texture derived from NASA Moon Trek data, centred on the last Ranger 7 camera-A frame (A199). Illustrative terrain; the exact impact point is marked by the app, not by a modelled crater.

height.source: LOLA DEM 256 ppd (NASA Moon Trek: LRO_LOLA_DEM_Global_256ppd_v06)
height.note: LOLA elevations are relative to a mean lunar radius of 1737.4 km.

albedo.source: LRO WAC global mosaic 303 ppd (NASA Moon Trek: LRO_WAC_Mosaic_Global_303ppd_v02)
albedo.note: Colour tint added for readability; crater detail is from the original mosaic.

sun.note: Direction of illumination baked into ranger7-lighting.png.
